mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount - settled_amount), 0) FROM fin_bill WHERE kind = #{kind} AND partner_id = #{partnerId}
mapper.update: UPDATE fin_bill SET settled_fc = settled_fc + #{amount}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id AS "id", kind AS "kind", partner_id AS "partnerId", currency AS "currency", amount_fc - settled_fc AS "remainingFc", amount - settled_amount AS "remainingBase" FROM fin_bill WHERE currency <> 'CNY' AND amount_fc <> settled_fc AND bill_date <= #{asOf}
mapper.update: UPDATE fin_bill SET discount_amount = discount_amount + #{amount}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE fin_bill SET bad_debt_amount = bad_debt_amount + #{amount}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE fin_bill SET invoiced_amount = invoiced_amount + #{amount}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND ABS(invoiced_amount + #{amount}) <= ABS(amount) AND (invoiced_amount + #{amount}) * amount >= 0

UPDATE fin_bill SET status = CASE WHEN settled_amount + #{amount} = amount THEN 'SETTLED' WHEN settled_amount + #{amount} = 0 THEN 'UNSETTLED' ELSE 'PARTIAL' END, settled_amount = settled_amount + #{amount}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND ((amount >= 0 AND settled_amount + #{amount} >= 0 AND settled_amount + #{amount} <= amount) OR (amount < 0 AND settled_amount + #{amount} <= 0 AND settled_amount + #{amount} >= amount))
mapper.select: SELECT m.category AS "category", SUM(i.close_adjust_net) AS "net" FROM scm_order_item i JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = i.material_id WHERE i.order_id = #{orderId} AND i.close_adjust_net <> 0 GROUP BY m.category

SELECT m.category AS "category", SUM(i.freight_share) AS "net" FROM scm_trade_doc_item i JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = i.material_id WHERE i.doc_id = #{tradeDocId} AND i.freight_share <> 0 GROUP BY m.category

SELECT m.category AS "category", SUM(i.amount - i.tax_amount) AS "net", SUM(i.tax_amount) AS "tax" FROM scm_trade_doc_item i JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = i.material_id WHERE i.doc_id = #{tradeDocId} GROUP BY m.category
